title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
lede: Trump backed Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang on Truth Social, saying the government sees no national security risk and that the attorney general has no evidence of wrongdoing.

points: Trump said Attorney General Todd Blanche found no evidence of unlawful conduct, though Blanche has made no formal statement.
TechCrunch notes it is unusual for a president to speak for such a finding, since the attorney general normally investigates independently.
Trump hinted at the outcome to a PBS journalist over the weekend, before the board announced it.
The concern centres on Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, which bought billions of dollars of Nvidia chips.
The same statement tells Nvidia to keep up its internal review of compliance with US export controls.

sections.text: Even as it clears Huang, the statement keeps Nvidia's export-control review running, so the question of how restricted AI chips may have reached China is still open.
